jobs.title: Team Manager, Software Development
jobs.description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?

Responsibilities

Lead two or more engineering teams which focus on building services for our Teamviewer ONE solution
Own all parts of the service lifecycle, including design, development, documentation, testing, tracking and operations
Continuously improve the product delivery process to reach a sustainable improvement
Define the team’s product roadmap and drive the system architecture
Deliver software meeting highest quality in terms of usability, stability, performance and security 
Be responsible for the quality the product the team delivers, as well as their overall effectiveness
Utilize proven technical best practices to inspire and guide the team, ensure that their solutions can be used by other teams in an easy and flexible manner 
Provide guidance in regards to technical, process or method related questions to the team and enable and foster an open feedback and communication culture
Ensure the personal and professional development of the team members to help them reach their full potential

Requirements

A university or college degree in the field of Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related subject
10+ years of software development experience focused on building services and products
3+ years of experience in leading and managing engineering teams, demonstrating strong leadership skills and a proven track record in team development.
Expertise in at least one modern programming language like Java, Typescript, C#, C++ with the ability and willingness to learn new technologies as needed..
Familiarity with integrating or leveraging AI services or frameworks in software architectures is a plus.
Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
Familiarity in using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, or similar to accelerate development, enhance code quality, and improve developer workflows.
Comfortable with working in high-demand set-up and ability to prioritize execution, hands-on mentality
Hands-on experience and knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing and operations
Hands-on guidance of engineering teams through initial project phases
Experienced in leading delivery of cloud-based solution that has required collaboration across different teams.
Experience with Azure/AWS cloud services such as: Kafka, Kubernetes, Redis, event streaming
A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.
Experience partnering with product and user experience teams
Strong communication skills to customers, business and technical partners
Strong data-driven mindset and a great attention to detail
A spirit of lifelong learning and eagerness to tackle new challenges every day
Fluency in English is mandatory, further languages such as Portuguese are a plus  

What We Offer

Contract location: Porto, Portugal
Onsite Onboarding in our HQ office for an optimal start
Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus and regular salary reviews
Public transport friendly offices
Special terms for local gyms
Access to Corporate Benefits platform with many discounts
Regular Team events and company-wide celebrations
Open door policy, no dress code rules, frequent all Hands and Leadership Lunches
Hybrid and Flexible work time with up to 50% home office
Work From Abroad Program allowing up to 40 days of work outside your contracting country
We celebrate diversity as one of core values, join and drive one of the c-a-r-e initiatives together with us!

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

If you require any accommodations or adjustments during the application or hiring process, including interview or onboarding support, please reach out to your Talent Acquisition Partner, who will be happy to support you.

jobs.title: K2 Developer
jobs.description:
Overview

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.

As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.

We invite you to join us. Why?

When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.

Responsibilities

Our newest opportunity is for a talented K2 Developer
, seconded to our Client from government sector in Doha, Qatar
.

This position is available on a 6-month short-term contract
, supporting the project’s immediate requirements.

The successful candidate will be designing, building, configuring, and maintaining enterprise-grade business process applications using the K2 product suite (K2 Five / K2 Cloud / Nintex Automation). This role transforms manual, paper-based, or fragmented workflows into streamlined, automated digital applications. The position collaborates with business analysts and IT teams to implement data models, user interfaces, and automated workflows that improve organizational efficiency, governance, and system connectivity.

We envisage success in this role to include;

K2 Application Architecture & Design
Workflow Modeling:
Translate complex business process maps into functional K2 automated workflows, utilizing advanced rules, inline functions, and conditional routing logic.
Smart Forms Development:
Design high-fidelity, responsive user interfaces using K2 Smart Forms, incorporating custom views, controls, validation rules, and expressions.
Smart Objects Integration:
Create and configure reusable K2 Smart Objects to establish secure data handshakes between K2 applications and external databases or SaaS platforms.

Integration & Core Engineering
API & System Integration:
Connect K2 workflows with core enterprise ecosystems (e.g., SharePoint, SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) via REST/SOAP Web Services and custom Service Brokers.
Database Programming:
Write, optimize, and maintain underlying SQL Server database components, including stored procedures, views, and complex triggers tied to K2 processes.
Custom Code Extension:
Author custom .NET/C# code snippets, custom assembly brokers, or custom Smart Forms controls to extend K2 platform capabilities when out-of-the-box features fall short.

Maintenance, Administration & Optimization
Platform Administration:
Troubleshoot failed workflow instances, manage server logs, configure environmental string fields, and handle package deployments using K2 Management and K2 Package & Deployment.
Performance Tuning:
Audit and refactor inefficient Smart Object queries and deeply nested Smart Form rules to minimize server-side processing times and form load latches.
Technical Documentation:
Create and update Technical Design Documents (TDD), environment migration playbooks, and structural data dictionaries for all custom K2 builds

Qualifications

To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a heavy emphasis on business process management (BPM) systems
, partnered with Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.

Furthermore, you should demonstrate:
Dedicated K2 Experience:
At least 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise applications explicitly built over K2 Five or K2 Cloud.
Enterprise Integration Track Record:
Proven experience successfully integrating K2 ecosystems with at least two standard enterprise architectures (such as SharePoint Online, Oracle, other ERP’s or Databases).
K2 Core Architecture:
Deep mastery of the K2 product suite (K2 Five or K2 Cloud), including K2 Designer, Smart Objects, Smart Forms, K2 Workflow, K2 Management, and K2 Workspace.
Database Programming:
Expert proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, advanced T-SQL scripting, writing optimized stored procedures, and complex views.
Software Development:
Strong programming foundations in .NET, C#, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (useful for extending out-of-thebox Smart Forms).
K2 Specific Credentials:
Nintex/K2 Certified Specialist, K2 Five Core Developer, or Nintex Automation Cloud Practitioner/Developer certifications.
Microsoft Ecosystem Certifications:
Microsoft Certified: AzureDeveloper Associate or relevant legacy certificates in SQL Server / .NET development.

KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.

We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

jobs.title: Sr Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Seer Solutions provides advanced and comprehensive digital solutions for financial institutions, enabling them to offer their products in a fast, easy, convenient, and cost-effective manner. By digitalizing processes, Seer Solutions helps financial partners adapt to the rapidly changing industry landscape. With strong research and development capabilities, the company ensures that its partners remain competitive. Seer Solution's dedicated team is committed to exceeding the expectations of its financial institution partners.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for a Senior Solution Engineer
position with the below requirement and qualification. The position is based in Dubai, JLT
.

Role and Responsibilities

Strong C#, ASP.NET Core (.NET 6/7/8), Web API
Hands-on microservices development using REST/gRPC and API Gateway patterns.
Strong SQL Server skills (stored procedures, query tuning, indexing, and troubleshooting).
Experience with EF Core, clean/layered architecture, and design patterns.
Practical experience with RabbitMQ/MassTransit or similar message-based integration.
Redis/distributed caching, Docker and Linux basics.
Secure API development: JWT/OAuth2, encryption basics.
FinTech, digital wallet, payment, remittance or banking domain experience.

Soft Skills

Strong ownership and accountability for assigned features and production issues.
Clear communication with developers, QA, business and support teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset; able to debug under pressure.
Reviews code, supports junior developers, and follows engineering standards.

Nice to have

Observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger/Open Telemetry.
CI/CD experience using Azure DevOps
Kubernetes, Azure cloud

Qualifications And Education Requirements

1. Minimum bachelor’s in computer science or information technology
6 -8 years of professional software development experience.
FinTech, digital wallet, payment, remittance or banking domain experience.
Experience leading small technical streams or acting as a senior contributor to a team.
Experience in database design/review, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting.
